subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the empty school hallway after school in <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the girl, a wavy black bob with violet-dyed tips underneath and one small curl sticking up on top, a white headband printed with violet stars tied in a big bow on top of her head, a black choker, an oversized white hoodie with a violet konte logo on the chest and a thin violet shoulder-bag strap across it, her face, hair and clothing taken from <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the thick, hand-drawn stack of manga manuscript pages, its top page a black-and-white ink page whose large top panel shows a paper whale over rainy rooftops, in <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is the school film festival poster, violet and sunflower yellow print on cream paper, "FILM FESTIVAL" across its top and "Entries due SUNDAY" in a yellow band near its bottom, in <Picture 4>.

summary: [keyframe completion] <Subject 2>, close in the hallway of <Subject 1>, hugging the manga stack of <Subject 3>, her face lighting up at the poster of <Subject 4>.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - the hallway's walls, the cork bulletin board, the rainy windows, the palette and the soft rainy daylight carry over; the framing is new and close.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - her face, hair and clothing hold; the sheet's cheerful expression and standing pose are remade as the description writes them.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - its design and colours hold; where it lies and how it is held are new.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - its design and colours hold; where it lies and how it is held are new.

detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] Close at standing eye level on <Subject 2> in the hallway of <Subject 1>, seen from a three-quarter angle: her head and shoulders fill the right two thirds of the frame, her face turned toward screen left. In the near foreground at the left edge, out of focus, the edge of the festival poster of <Subject 4> on the cork school bulletin board, its bold violet "FILM FESTIVAL" heading half in frame, softly out of focus. Behind her on the right, the row of rainy hallway windows glows soft white, out of focus, raindrops on the glass. Both of her arms hug the thick manga stack of <Subject 3> against her chest, its top edge just above the bottom edge of the frame. Her eyes are wide open with big sparkling highlights, pupils toward screen left, fixed on the poster; her eyebrows lifted high, her lips parted in a breathless, delighted smile, a faint pink blush on her cheeks. Soft, cool rainy daylight from the windows behind her rims her hair.
